entry_points.text: Class entries set runnable and queued state before arrival callbacks and dispatch, clear membership and ops before departure callbacks, end slices on voluntary and directed yields, and ignore same-class wakeups while requesting requeue when immediates exist.

Current accounting applies pending out-of-band slice, consumes bounded slice and charges rescue service; a balance callback drains pending dispatch and reenqueue work; interrupt work runs deferred handlers in runqueue context.

exports.text: Locked transition iteration skips idle-class and dead tasks, locks the first eligible runqueue and records queue and task, else reports exhaustion; a wait helper returns at once unless the task is dispatching, then blocks until it leaves that state.

Enqueue picks callback, direct, local, global or bypass paths, isolates migration and restore, skips callbacks when offline, bypassing, exiting or capless, and ejects past a repeat cap; a mover inserts head or tail locally; a resolver force-admits stuck tasks then diverts capless ones to rescue or reject; online joins scheduler and cpu state; clock prefers cached time.

Detach removes a task from its dispatch queue or cancels deferred local linkage and holding state when unattached; unlink drops priority and list membership, decrements counts and refreshes the cached first task on non-builtin queues.

Reenqueue skips bypass, checks local caps, keeps local nodes on the owning runqueue and user nodes on the caller queue, merges flags on queued nodes and runs cheap local or remote notify paths; reject drain resubmits with cap reasons; revoke check records missing caps and topology; rescue debit tracks bounded budget with decayed average; header variants are no-ops without sub-schedulers.

hazards.text: Diagnostics warn on destroyed queue dispatch, builtin virtual time use, mixed FIFO and priority use, misplaced immediate marking and missing scheduler root, and report errors for disallowed reenqueue targets.

Dequeue and transfer race on a holder marker resolved under the proper guard; migration-disabled precedes affinity tests; class visibility is raised for intervening wakeups; dispatch completion stays lock-free for waiters with brief custody retries; user scans abort on bypass, validate across migrations and yield; queue ids are rechecked after barriers against concurrent destruction.

Ids are SCX_DSQ_LOCAL, SCX_DSQ_GLOBAL, SCX_DSQ_INVALID, SCX_DSQ_BYPASS with rescue and reject, SCX_DSQ_LOCAL_ON with mask and builtin flag; enqueue uses SCX_ENQ_HEAD, SCX_ENQ_PREEMPT, SCX_ENQ_DSQ_PRIQ, SCX_ENQ_APPLY_SLICE and SCX_ENQ_CLEAR_OPSS with slice, nested, immediate and fallback; iteration uses SCX_TASK_ITER_BATCH and SCX_TASK_CURSOR; tasks use SCX_TASK_DEAD, SCX_TASK_IN_CUSTODY, SCX_TASK_PROTECTED and SCX_TASK_IMMED with SCX_OPSS_NONE and queueing phases; runqueues use SCX_RQ_IN_WAKEUP, SCX_RQ_IN_DISPATCH and SCX_RQ_BAL_CB_PENDING; slice joins 43-bit duration, scheduler id and pending bit.
Implementation relies on external list, single-access, atomic, barrier, diagnostic, container and processor helpers owned elsewhere and cited only by identifier.

invariants.text: Iteration uses cgroup preorder including dead members when a cgroup context exists, else a global list walk from a movable cursor that skips markers and ends at a sentinel; it unlocks and yields after a fixed batch to bound locked scans, and missing the sentinel is fatal.

Enable state lives in one atomic with unconditional exchange and conditional exchange from an expected value; operation wait spins with relaxation on acquire loads until the observed state differs, pairing with release clears.

Resolution separates current, named, global and user queues with global fallback; enqueue resolves local ids, sanitizes flags, locks only non-owner queues, rejects virtual time on builtins, keeps priority tree with head and FIFO head past protected tasks, bumps sequence and release-clears ops; counts use single writes; explicit slice wins, virtual time is priority-only.

Same-queue dispatch enqueues directly; cross-queue publishes holder, releases ops, switches locks, then completes locally, falls back to global when remote running is impossible, or migrates with reschedule when outranking; custody exits only when marked and not migrating via stickiness set before deactivation and cleared on arrival; remote checks reject disabled, affinity and offline targets.

Deferred runs direct locals, local reenqueues, user reenqueues then rejection; direct entries drain singly as handling may drop the lock, unlinking destination, flags, slice and time; locked scheduling prefers wakeup and existing balance or dispatch marks over cross-cpu wake; a wrapper forwards reenqueue under read protection; records clear under guard before scans.

Requeue scans assign one reason per task with marks cleared before and after, move selections aside before reinsertion, skip stuck and foreign tasks, exempt protected and rescue locally, prefer immediate and revocation causes, evict running capless tasks on revocation, and let user queues follow generic flags.

Enqueue caps are none under ignore, immediate for immediates else base, skipped by unmigratable and rescue; preempt is none when forced, outside class or same subtree else needs a cap with an empty build; without sub-schedulers local is the runqueue queue; post-enqueue exits custody for terminal inserts, raises visibility and expires slices for preempts; remote direct defers and stashes only for the current task.

Rescue budget grows with elapsed time scaled by bandwidth with session caps and saturation shortcut; immediate admission needs no holder, empty wait and full quantum else timer paces; admission records holder, slice and snapshot, programs slice and arms an idempotent timer stretched for deficits; remaining service floors at zero with clamped ticks and decayed usage.

Runnable membership tail-inserts with negative absent marker, queued flag and count preserving order; out-of-band slice packs scheduler id, duration and pending bit atomically, discards on owner mismatch and clamps extremes; default refill preserves pending requests; events bump per-cpu counters with traces and fixed-width dumps.

locks.text: Runqueue lock covers remote moves, deferred drains, requeue scans, dequeue, unlink, runnable insert and dispatch removal with user requeue migrating the lock and irq work wrapping handlers; non-owner queues take their own guard while owner queues use the runqueue lock; deferred nodes use a dedicated spinlock with barrier; clears are release, waits acquire, holder verified before moves.

state_machines.text: Operation state goes none to queueing in callbacks to queued or dispatch handling to none with release after custody; direct dispatch resets idle or queueing to idle; dequeue exchanges queued to idle or waits for dispatching to finish; holder is published before clearing and reset to invalid after the move.

structs.text: Iterator holds movable cursor with step count and optional cgroup position plus locked queue, flags and task; tasks carry operation state, queue links and priority node, slice and virtual time, custody, protection and immediacy marks, holder and sticky placement, direct stash with target and timing, sequence and runnable linkage.

Runqueue keeps flags, cached clock, local queues, immediate count, dispatch marks, runnable list with counts, deferred lists and stashed activation; queues keep identity, lock, list with priority index and cached head, sequence, count and per-cpu deferred nodes.
